title: Goodwill Share for Northgate Appointment Moves on Large-Item Orders
content:
**Northgate Store and Online Orders — late-change goodwill extra for Northgate moves.** On the late-change goodwill refund of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order, the number of Northgate moves is the order's reschedule count less the customer's confirmed reschedule requests on the order, and it adds a share of the latest late-change fee:

| Northgate moves | Extra percentage |
|---|---|
| three or more | 50 percent |
| exactly two | 25 percent |
| a single move | nothing |

**Hypothetical record.** A reschedule count of 5 with 2 confirmed customer requests is 3 moves and adds 50 percent; a count of 4 with 2 confirmed requests is 2 moves and adds 25 percent.
